description: Coal Production By Province is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). Coal production by month from PK Thinker. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Conventional Fuels. Its keywords are production. The portal shows 2017-08-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY-NC-ND (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
